answer: To keep false watchers from claiming hill-signal bounties, a ridge post stakes 31.6 POA in bin VL-9 and lights a violet lantern at mast H-14. The runner carries a saffron cloth punch-card with 11 irregular holes to the south hut within 8 min; the hut stamps hole #7 only if azimuth is 214±3 degrees and dye batch is SV-48. A clerk with a 2-axis goniometer logs two independent angles. Azimuth drift over 3 degrees or a hole-count mismatch burns 11.2 POA and benches the runner 4 epochs. If the cloth arrives after 8 min, the stake refunds 27.9 POA after 1 epoch minus a 2.1 POA late cut.
